name: Persona mask: funny face changer to switch faces

ios.desc:
Change the way you look in a tap. Make awesome video selfies or mask-ed photos that WIN BIG!

Fun with presidents (and the first lady to be):
You think politicians play with you? Now play with politicians! Put on masks of Donald Trump, Barack Obama, Melania Trump, Vladimir Putin, Angela Merkel and record your official message to the Nation.

Share your selfie animations with friends via your favorite messengers and social networks. The time to start is NOW!
